description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

alive.last_commit_message:
feat(reference): wire Harness2 meta-loop & recall

Complete the single-run and outer-loop wiring for the Harness2
primitives introduced in the preceding commits:

- Stamp prefix-stage runmark metadata (`snapshot_id`, `model`,
  `prefix_fingerprint`) into `campaign_artifacts.metadata_json` via
  `update_artifact_metadata` when `architect` and `threat_modeler`
  complete, and verify the stored DB runmark in
  `_make_prefix_reuse_callbacks` alongside the in-process completion
  gate before reusing an artifact across cross-functional campaigns.
- Deduplicate `(run_id, category, learning)` in `record_learning`,
  exclude `causal_edit` attributions from general audit `recall()` by
  default, and add `render_stage_learnings_for_agent` (with CP-4
  untrusted-content fencing) wired into `load_workflow_from_json` via
  a per-campaign cached `before_model_callback` and a single-channel
  `after_model_callback` on `reflector`.
- Add `ResearchGraphSynthesizer.evolve_iteration` to orchestrate the
  Propose-Probe-Select-Reflect loop with fail-safe defaults: when no
  `probe_runner` or `selector_fn` is provided, it retains `baseline`
  (`resolved_by="unprobed"`), writes no synthetic rollouts, and never
  persists reflections not produced by `reflector_fn`.

Change-Id: I5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f7081
